questions: Are the cars within each set initially spaced apart, or could they be arbitrarily close to each other (e.g., bumper-to-bumper)?
Do we count collisions between cars moving in the same direction if they are initially overlapping or pass through each other due to previous collisions?
Is the speed constant and identical for all cars, and if so, is it explicitly 1 unit per time step or arbitrary?
Should collisions be counted at the exact moment of meeting, or over the entire infinite timeline (e.g., if cars pass through and later meet other cars again)?
Are the two sets of cars initially interleaved or separated, i.e., do left-to-right cars start all to the left of all right-to-left cars?
Is 'n' guaranteed to be a non-negative integer, and if negative, what should the function do?
Do we consider collisions only between distinct pairs, or if three cars meet at a point, does that count as multiple collisions?
Is the road one-dimensional, and are cars treated as points or have non-zero size?
